status: Seven installed structures. Native placement in four rotations, support, under-deck transport, water retention/spill parity and walking passed main 90; exact save/reload and six walking destinations passed 91. Eight concrete platform size/height variants are authored and export-checked; native placement untested. Three concrete side platforms (legless decks hung beside a reinforced dam block) are authored; native placement untested. Fifteen steel structures (cantilevers 10/12/15, truss bridges 8/10/12/15, stackable columns 1-6 high, corner-supported decks 3×3 and 5×5) are authored and export-checked; native placement untested. Initial cost balance; steel structures carry heavy High-Grade Steel and Concrete costs pending the cost rework.

legDecks.$comment: Placement tools, never entities: each places the named deck plus one stack of steel columns per deck foundation (SteelDeckToolSpec, src/DeepFrontier/Scripts/SteelStructures). clearance = deck layers above the pointed surface; columns are listed by height; maxDepth = longest leg below the deck.

buildings.name: Sandstone Masonry Block
buildings.description: Mortared sandstone block. Holds back water and supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: Stack them right and the river has to ask permission.

buildings.name: Brick Block
buildings.description: Brick block laid in cement. Holds back water and supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: Fired, stacked and mortared: the river can knock all it likes.

buildings.name: Concrete Levee Block
buildings.description: Cast concrete block. Holds back water and supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: Poured once, there for good.

buildings.name: Reinforced Overhang 8x1
buildings.description: One anchor tile carries seven overhanging tiles. Supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: One good anchor and a lot of nerve.

buildings.name: Concrete Platform 3x3 (3 high)
buildings.description: A deck on four corner legs with a clear bay underneath for paths, power shafts and tubeways. Supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: Four legs, one deck and plenty of room underneath.

buildings.name: Reinforced Dam Block
buildings.description: Holds back water and supports construction on top. Concrete Side Platforms can hang from its sides.
buildings.flavor: Built to hold a river, and a platform or two on the side.

buildings.name: Concrete Overflow Dam
buildings.description: Holds water up to 0.65 m and lets the rest spill over the top. Supports construction on top.
buildings.flavor: Keeps the pond full and lets the rest go over the top.
